protocol.prompt: Protocol acceptance exercise. Run exactly three separate sequential shell calls, waiting for each result: (1) node -e "console.log(17*19)" (2) node -e "console.log(23*29)" (3) node -e "console.log(31*37)". Do not combine calls. Then write answer.json containing the array of these three observed numbers. Do not rerun commands or read unrelated files. Final response: the numbers only.
protocol.scope: Protocol/cache observation with deterministic switch, one task per arm; not stable performance, routing quality or billed savings.
